caption:
shopping for skincare in Korea and don't know where to start?

You don't need 10 steps. These five cover the basics, in the order they go on.

1. Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Toner (라운드랩 1025 독도 토너). Watery, goes on first.
2. Anua Heartleaf 77 Soothing Toner (아누아 어성초 77 수딩 토너). For oily, easily irritated skin.
3. Torriden Dive-In Serum (토리든 다이브인 세럼). Light hydration you can layer.
4. Goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Serum (구달 청귤 비타C 세럼). A gentle first vitamin C.
5. Aestura Atobarrier 365 Cream (에스트라 아토베리어365 크림). Seals it all in.

Doctor's note: vitamin C can tingle at first. Start every other night and see how your skin feels.

Save this and show the Korean names to the staff in store. Part 2 is next.
